The '''Kishiwada October Festival''' (岸和田十月祭礼, ''Kishiwada Jūgatsu Sairei'') is the collective name for the [[だんじり祭|danjiri]] festivals held annually in October across six districts of [[:en:岸和田市|Kishiwada City]], [[:en:大阪府|Osaka Prefecture]]. A coordinating annual festival committee (''nenbanyaku'') overseeing all districts is also organized. These six districts are collectively known locally as ''Yamate'' (山手, "mountain side") or ''Ue'' (上, meaning "upstream"), and the festivals take place in the areas surrounding [[東岸和田駅|Higashi-Kishiwada Station]], [[下松駅 (大阪府)|Kudamatsu Station]], and [[久米田駅|Kumeda Station]] on the [[西日本旅客鉄道|JR West]] [[阪和線|Hanwa Line]].

== District overview and festival neighborhoods ==
=== Higashi-Kishiwada ===
Corresponds to the former [[土生郷村|Habukigō-mura]] and [[有真香村|Arimaka-mura]] of the former [[:en:泉南郡|Sennō District]]. From 2008 (the 20th year of the Heisei era), the Asahi-Ōta and Shūsai districts merged to form the Higashi-Kishiwada district. A portable shrine procession (''mikoshi no tōgyo'') can be seen at [[矢代寸神社|Yashirozaki Shrine]].
* (Former) Asahi-Ōta district
** Habuchō (Habu Shrine)
** Sakusaichō ([[岸和田天神宮|Kishiwada Tenjingū]])
** Hatachō (Hata Shrine)
** Gokurakujichō, Nagarekichō ([[矢代寸神社|Yashirozaki Shrine]])
* (Former) Shūsai district
** Hattachō, Kamisuyachō, Magamichō ([[矢代寸神社|Yashirozaki Shrine]])
** Habutakichō, Amazawatakichō, Kazurachō ([[意賀美神社 (岸和田市)|Okamijinja]])

=== Minami-Kamorido ===
Corresponds to the former [[南掃守村|Minami-Kamorido Village]] of the former Sennō District.
* Nishinouchichō, Yasakachō, Kudamatsuchō (Hyōzu Shrine)
* Kamamatsuchō (Kamimatsu Sugawara Shrine)
* Yamashitachō (Kishiwada Tenjingū)
* Onyūchō, Naka-onyūchō, Fukudachō (Onyū Sugawara Shrine)

=== Yagi ===
Roughly corresponds to the former [[八木村 (大阪府)|Yagi Village]] of the former Sennō District. On the second day, a ''Gyōki-mairi'' pilgrimage to [[久米田寺|Kumedadera]] is held.
* Nakaiichō, Yoshiiichō, Arakichō, Shimaikedachō, Midorochō, Nishiōjichō, Komatsusatochō, Gakuchō, Gakunoharachō, Ōchō, Ikejirichō ([[夜疑神社|Yagi Shrine]])

=== Yamanao ===
Corresponds to the former [[山直下村|Yamanao-shimo Village]] of the former Sennō District. Tajimechō and Imakichō also participate in the Yagi district's ''Gyōki-mairi''.
* Imakichō (Imaki Sugawara Shrine)
* Tajimechō (Tajime Sugawara Shrine)
* Mayuchō (Awaji Shrine)
* Sandachō, Sanda-Ogura (Hokura Shrine)
* Okayamachō-Yamadekōji, Okayamachō-Ōnishikōji, Okayamachō-Higashidekōji (Okayamachō Sugawara Shrine)

=== Yamanao-Minami ===
Corresponds to the former [[山直上村|Yamanao-kami Village]] of the former Sennō District. On the second day, all neighborhoods proceed to [[積川神社|Tsumugawa Shrine]].
* Kanekichō (Kusumoto Shrine)
* Yamanao-nakamachi (Nakamura Shrine)
* Inabachō-nishi, Inabachō-higashi (Inaba Sugawara Shrine)
* Tsumugawachō ([[積川神社|Tsumugawa Shrine]])

=== Yamataki ===
Corresponds to the former [[山滝村|Yamataki Village]] of the former [[:en:泉北郡|Izumi-kita District]]. A portable shrine procession (''mikoshi no tōgyo'') can be seen at Yamanao Shrine.
* [[内畑町|Uchibatachō]], Uchibatachō-Shimode (Yamanao Shrine)
* [[大沢町 (岸和田市)|Ōsawachō]] (Ōsawa Sugawara Shrine)

== Schedule ==
* Trial pull (''shiken biki''): The Sunday before the first Monday of October
* Eve festival (''yoimiya''): The Saturday before the main festival day
* Main festival (''honmiya''): The Sunday before [[:en:体育の日|Sports Day]]

* [[春木だんじり祭|Haruki Danjiri Festival]]
* [[:en:清原和博|Kazuhiro Kiyohara]] — His family home is in the Yagi district; he has participated in the danjiri festival when returning home.
*[[矢代寸神社|Yashirozaki Shrine]] — Five danjiri floats from Hattachō, Magamichō, Kamisuyachō, Gokurakujichō, and Nagarekichō enter the shrine as part of the Higashi-Kishiwada danjiri festival. A ''mikoshi'' procession, unusual for a danjiri festival, is held at the shrine exit ceremony (''miyade'').
